blocks.raw: <WikiExamTable headers=["DRRM Component", "Framework", "Site Planning Application"] rows=[["**Hazard Mapping**", "Identify tsunami, flood, landslide, seismic, volcanic hazards at site location", "Determines site suitability; informs setback, height, and building design requirements"], ["**Vulnerability Assessment**", "Evaluate exposure of buildings, infrastructure, and populations to identified hazards", "Drives resilience design priorities: elevated utilities, flexible utility connections, emergency egress"], ["**Risk Reduction**", "Design passive and active measures to reduce hazard impact", "Retention/detention basins, green infrastructure, early warning systems, accessible evacuation routes"], ["**Coastal Resilience (Post-Yolanda)**", "40m no-build zone from mean high tide in affected provinces; mangrove restoration; beach nourishment", "Restricts development in highest-risk coastal areas; mandates setback compliance"], ["**Seismic Resilience**", "5m minimum setback from PHIVOLCS-mapped active faults; flexible utility connections", "Protects structures; allows utility system deformation without rupture"], ["**Flood Resilience**", "Flood zoning; elevation standards; retention basins; permeable surfaces; SuDS principles", "Reduces inundation depth/duration; facilitates drainage; delays runoff"], ["**Climate Change Integration**", "Hazard escalation scenarios; 1.5\u00b0C warming adaptation; precipitation/sea-level rise projections", "Plan for intensification of hazards; design for future climate, not historical climate"], ["**DRRM Governance**", "LGU DRRM offices; 5% IRA DRRM fund allocation; CLUP mainstreaming (RA 10121)", "Ensures DRRM is funded, coordinated, and legally binding across all planning"]] />

blocks.raw: <Tip>**DRRM is mainstreamed into CLUPs and site design.** Always ask: What hazards threaten this site? What RA 10121 requirements apply? What design resilience mitigations are needed? Climate change intensifies all hazards.</Tip>
